programme.desc: S3:E5 Épisode 5 - Le pouvoir des fleurs | Construisons un igloo ! | Livraison spéciale pour Pingu

programme.title: Pingu
programme.desc: S3:E6 Épisode 6 - La surprise d'anniversaire de maman | Pingu prend son envol | Pingu glisse vers la gloire

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: Je lai vu la première
programme.desc: Carly et Sam s'intéressent au même garçon, mais elles se jurent qu'il ne sèmera pas la zizanie entre elles. Malheureusement, les choses ne se déroulent pas si facilement et elles finissent par entrer en compétition.

programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Cest pas de la tarte
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Spencer emmènent Freddie dans leur boutique de tartes préférée. A leur arrivée, ils apprennent que le propriétaire a disparu en emportant la recette des tartes avec lui.

programme.title: Spencer est normal
programme.desc: Alors qu'il souhaite pimenter un peu la tradition de Noël avec un arbre peu conventionnel, Spencer met accidentellement le feu aux cadeaux de Carly. Bouleversée, elle rêve d'avoir un frère normal.

programme.title: Le premier baiser
programme.desc: Alors que Freddie confie à Carly qu'il n'a jamais embrassé une fille, Sam surprend leur conversation et dévoile le secret de Freddie sur Internet.

programme.title: Le concours
programme.desc: L'équipe organise un concours sur iCarly.com pour gagner une voiture.

programme.title: Meilleurs ennemis
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie vexent une starlette du web dénommée Fred. Ce dernier tente alors de convaincre ses abonnés vidéo de ne plus jamais regarder iCarly.

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: It Came from the Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Un malin renard utilise son ingéniosité pour tirer profit de trois fermiers faibles d'esprit qui se résolvent à utiliser des tactiques extrêmes pour protéger leurs poulets...

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E24 Un ami de trop - C'est les vacances. Roméo, qui ne veut surtout pas se retrouver seul, décide de faire ami-ami avec Bernie. Il l'invite même chez lui dans sa superbe maison. Corneil se sent de plus en plus délaissé. D'autant plus que l'amitié de Roméo envers Bernie est intéressée…

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E25 Le retour de Jojo - Le nouveau chef de la cafétéria n'est pas seulement un cuisinier épouvantable, c'est aussi un ancien voleur. Corneil reconnaît immédiatement Joe Scoundrel, le voleur de tableaux qu'il a mis sous les verrous. Si Joe Scoundrel est revenu en ville, c'est pour revoir l'inspecteur Cornélius.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E26 Le Dogsitter show - Bernie propose à Corneil de participer au casting du « Dogsitter Show », une série mettant en scène un chien idiot et un « dogsitter » génial. Pour Corneil, c'est hors de question. Mais lorsque Bernie l'accuse de manquer de sens de l'humour, Corneil accepte.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E27 Sommeil cornélien - Depuis peu, Corneil parle pendant son sommeil. C'est une catastrophe ! Si quelqu'un l'entendait, c'en serait fini de son secret ! Pour ne rien arranger, il doit dormir ce soir dans la chambre de John et Beth.

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S3:E9 The Ni Ni Tree - True et Bartleby doivent traverser la forêt de nuit pour aider les Yétis à trouver davantage de lumières Ni Ni.

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S3:E10 Scratch and Share - Il y a des Yétis Rouges et des Yétis Bleus… et les deux veulent le Bâton Spécial à Gratter ! Leur désaccord perturbe l'équilibre de la forêt. True pourra-t-elle les convaincre de coopérer et de partager ?

programme.title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
programme.desc: S1:E1 Big Mossy Mess - Quand Bartleby rapporte chez lui un peu de mousse spéciale Zazoony, elle se met soudain à pousser de façon incontrôlable ! C'est maintenant à True d'arrêter sa propagation avant que la mousse ne recouvre tout le Royaume Arc-en-ciel.

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: S1:E29 Le Carnaval D'Automne - Gargamel et Hogatha parviendront-ils à détruire les Schtroumpfs le jour de leur carnaval ? Dame Nature pourra-t-elle réparer l'erreur qui a teint le pauvre Schtroumpf Paresseux en rouge vif ?

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: S1:E30 Le Noble Dix-Cors - Le petit roi Gérard a été transformé en cerf par les enchantements maléfiques de son cousin Malcolm le Méchant. Les Schtroumpfs empêcheront-ils que la dépouille du roi n'orne le mur de l'usurpateur ?

programme.title: Les Schtroumpfs
programme.desc: S1:E31 Le Millénaire Des Druides - Le Grand Schtroumpf parviendra-t-il à vaincre le pouvoir terrifiant des Druides d'autrefois grâce à la capsule que lui ont léguée les Grands Ancêtres ?

programme.title: Bobby et les Chasseurs de fantômes
programme.desc: Sanne, 13 ans, raffole des histoires fantastiques que lui raconte son père, Lucas, un chasseur de spectres très réputé.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: Seconde Guerre Mondiale. Le capitaine américain Jack Wosick, récemment tombé en disgrâce, se voit offrir un moyen de se racheter lorsqu'on lui propose de commander une unité de marginaux sans aucune discipline, les « War Pigs ».

programme.title: Get Fast
programme.desc: Quand son complice est enlevé après un braquage spectaculaire, un voleur notoire se lance à sa recherche sur le territoire d'un impitoyable baron de la drogue. Jusqu'où va la loyauté entre criminels quand les balles commencent à siffler ?

programme.title: Justice Armée
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il apprend que son frère a été assassiné pendant son service militaire, Webster se met à la recherche des auteurs du meurtre. Il découvre alors une conspiration qui remonte jusqu'au gouvernement américain.

programme.title: Cartel Escape
programme.desc: Carla, une jeune mexicaine, se retrouve par accident aux États-Unis après avoir traversé un tunnel abandonné. Au cœur du désert de Yucca Valley, elle se retrouve alors prise dans un jeu mortel du chat et de la souris entre la CIA, le cartel et des informateurs du gouvernement.

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une championne de course en puissance qui voit sa vie basculer lorsque son père décède. Mineure, elle ne peut compter que sur son frère qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis dix ans et qui est toxicomane. Ensemble, ils vont essayer de remonter la pente grâce à leur passion commune : la course automobile.

programme.title: Giggino ‘o bello
programme.desc: Un vieux criminel, Nonno, se cache dans une cave avec Giggino son petit-fils.

programme.title: L'étrange disparition de M. Walter Werner
programme.desc: Où est donc passé Walter ? Alban semble être le seul à s'interroger.

programme.title: Entre chien et loup
programme.desc: Sohrab, un jeune soldat enrôlé dans l'armée, se retrouve face à ses congénères lors d'une manifestation.

programme.title: Le grand jeu
programme.desc: Mathias et Alex ont rendez-vous à l'aube sur un petit parking en pleine campagne. Ils se connaissent bien mais tout semble les opposer. Pourtant, un secret les unit. Cette année encore, rien ne pourra les détourner de ce qu'ils sont venus accomplir. Que nous révèlera leur entreprise mystérieuse et fantasque ?

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre d'une flamme
programme.desc: Un couple préhistorique tente d'allumer un feu...

programme.title: Peine perdue
programme.desc: Une fin d'après-midi au bord d'une rivière, un concert près de l'eau. L'étrange Rodolphe remarque Alex, jeune homme timide qui n'a d'yeux que pour Julia, parisienne en vacances. Rodolphe entreprend de l'aider, à sa manière...

programme.title: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés
programme.desc: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés. C'est notre manière pour nous tenir debout. Deux combats, deux époques, pour une même soif de reconnaissance, sur deux histoires qui ne finissent pas de ricocher l'une sur l'autre.

programme.title: Je sens le beat qui monte en moi
programme.desc: Rosalba, jeune guide touristique, souffre d'une affection étrange : la moindre mélodie provoque chez elle gesticulation et danse de façon aussi subtile qu'incontrôlable. Malgré ses ruses pour cacher son excentricité, ce corps indomptable pourrait bien séduire son surprenant collègue Alain...

programme.title: Oktapodi
programme.desc: Pour échapper aux griffes d'un commis cuisinier, deux poulpes se lancent dans une burlesque course poursuite. Pourtant, malgré leur improbable succès pour échapper à leur fatale destinée, leur combat pour rester unis ne semble pas fini.

programme.title: Expire
programme.desc: Un brouillard toxique, le Smog, a recouvert la planète et oblige les hommes à vivre confinés. Mais quand on a quinze ans, comme Juliette, la vraie vie est dehors.

programme.title: La cage
programme.desc: C'est la rencontre entre un ours prisonnier de sa cage et qui ne sait pas chanter, et un petit oiseau qui ne sait pas voler, mais qui chante très bien. Chacun va s'enrichir de l'amitié de l'autre et surmonter ses handicaps.

programme.title: Mur
programme.desc: Un soir d'hiver, par un temps de neige, une femme se rend à son travail. L'environnement est hostile, le labeur éreintant. Une fenêtre ne ferme plus : il neige à l‘intérieur... Le lieu de corvée devient espace de découverte.

programme.title: Ce que cache la neige
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a découvert l'infidélité de sa femme, Alexandre, 35 ans, rumine sa colère. Une idée l'obsède : tuer sa femme pour lui faire payer sa traîtrise. A bout, il se rend dans les locaux de la Simile, une société qui pourra l'aider à concrétiser son projet…

programme.title: A rebours
programme.desc: Alors que Sylvie est en retard pour ouvrir l'épicerie dans laquelle elle travaille, deux clients font irruption : Frank, un jeune homme au visage grave que Sylvie semble connaître, et Julie, une jeune femme qui a l'air de traverser une bien mauvaise passe. Une dispute éclate rapidement entre eux ...

programme.title: Voiler la face
programme.desc: Amine est un jeune musulman rigoriste, très amoureux de sa femme, Enora, une jeune convertie. Lorsque sa femme reçoit une amie, qui comme elle, porte le voile intégral, Amine quitte systématiquement l'appartement et ne voit jamais le visage de l'invitée. Jusqu'au jour où les remarques de ses amis éveillent sa jalousie. Le doute s'insinue dans l'esprit d'Amine : qui se cache sous la burqa ?

programme.title: Navire
programme.desc: Des lettres d'amour jamais envoyées. Un navire miniature qui n'a jamais vogué. Des papiers roulés dans ses voiles. La mer tout autour qui laisse émerger une voix.

programme.title: Dolça
programme.desc: Dans un village du Sud de la France, Dolça, une jeune lycéenne, babysitte Sam, un enfant de dix ans avec qui elle a une relation très complice, jusqu'à ce qu'elle entame une liaison avec son père cette liaison va bouleverser sa relation avec l'enfant.

programme.title: Les guerriers
programme.desc: Rongé par ses désirs autant que ses frustrations, Thomas, seize ans, peine à se construire. Si bien qu'il lui est bientôt impossible de contenir cette rage sourde qui l'anime. Mais loin de le détruire, la colère est son premier élan vers la liberté.

programme.title: Féroce
programme.desc: Après avoir été kidnappé dans son appartement, un jeune cadre d'entreprise se réveille en pleine forêt. Il se retrouve alors traqué par un mystérieux chasseur.

programme.title: Time Rodent
programme.desc: Dans un futur lointain où la nuit a dévoré le jour, les habitants d'un monde en mutation accélérée se nourrissent exclusivement de lumière artificielle.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Il est trentenaire et habite encore chez sa mère. Taciturne et tourmenté, il a définitivement perdu contact avec la réalité. Une nuit, il profite de l'absence de sa mère pour se libérer une fois pour toutes de ses démons intérieurs.

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: John Gray, un banquier aux manières douces, est renversé par une voiture et perd la plupart de ses souvenirs. Lorsqu'il sort de l'hôpital, il a des flashbacks qui ne cadrent pas avec sa vie actuelle. Après un appel téléphonique étrange et une tentative d'assassinat de sa femme, Gray est assassiné. Il est contraint de se rendre à Los Angeles afin de résoudre le crime et de reconstituer son mystérieux passé.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Un volcan endormi au cœur de la forêt turque renferme un secret mortel. Parfaitement conservés, des oeufs de ptérodactyle sont prêts à éclore...

programme.title: Tokyo Tribe
programme.desc: Dans un Tokyo futuriste, la ville est divisée en quartiers, dirigés par des gangs distincts. Mera, le chef de l'un d'eux, souhaite régler une affaire personnelle avec un membre d'une faction rivale, entraînant ainsi une guerre totale.

programme.title: Le Requin Mutant
programme.desc: Les invités d'un mariage sur une île doivent faire face à un requin à six têtes qui attaque l'île.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Un prince et son serviteur apprennent qu'une magnifique princesse est plongée dans un sommeil éternel suite à une malédiction. Ils se lancent dans un dangereux périple et doivent affronter une reine maléfique et une armée de morts-vivants pour la délivrer.

programme.title: High School U.s.a.
programme.desc: Dans une classe de terminale, J.J. poursuit la petite amie d'un rival d'une classe supérieure.

programme.title: Jungle 2 Jungle
programme.desc: Michael Cromwell, brillant courtier prêt à se remarier, entreprend un voyage au coeur de la jungle amazonienne pour divorcer de sa première femme. Il découvre ainsi qu'il est le père d'un garçon de 13 ans, Mimi-Siku, élevé par les indiens. Dans un moment d'égarement il accepte de le ramener avec lui. Un beau choc des cultures en perspective !

programme.title: Gun, Robert Altman Presents
programme.desc: Dans cette série de six épisodes, la vie de plusieurs personnages sans lien entre eux change radicalement lorsqu'ils rencontrent le même pistolet semi-automatique .45 à poignée en perle. Rosanna Arquette, James Gandolfini, Daryl Hannah, Kirstin Dunst, Martin Sheen et Carrie Fisher apparaissent dans cette série.

programme.title: Un Été D'enfer
programme.desc: Elisabeth est à la recherche de sa soeur Valérie, disparue mystérieusement trois mois auparavant. Trouvant les hommes du commissaire Turielle trop lents dans leur enquête, elle engage un détective privé, Philippe Darland. L'enquête de celui-ci l'entraîne rapidement dans les milieux de la drogue où il découvre que le grand patron du réseau n'est autre que le commissaire Turielle.

programme.title: Priez Pour La Mariée
programme.desc: Un groupe de demoiselles d'honneur se rend à Napa pour un enterrement de vie de jeune fille et se retrouve en grand danger lorsqu'un homme portant un masque de loup cherche à venger la mort de son ami.

programme.title: Ennemis rapprochés
programme.desc: Après un affrontement avec la police britannique, Frankie McGuire, membre de l'IRA, doit quitter l'Irlande pour les États-Unis. Il se cache dans une famille d'origine irlandaise, les O'Meary, dont le père, gagne sa vie en tant que policier.

programme.title: L'Enfer du Devoir
programme.desc: Du Vietnam au Liban, le colonel Terry Childers a combattu sur tous les fronts. Vénéré par ses hommes, il est presque devenu une légende. Une tuerie au Yemen conduit le héros de l'Amérique devant un tribunal militaire.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un entrepreneur militaire reconnu revient sur le site de ses plus grands triomphes de carrière et renoue avec un amour de son passé, tout en craquant de manière inattendue pour une dure à cuire de l'Air Force qui lui est assignée.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis
programme.desc: Juillet 1945. Le navire américain USS INDIANAPOLIS, commandé par le capitaine McVay (Nicolas Cage), est en mission secrète. Parti livrer des composants de la bombe atomique larguée sur Hiroshima, il est torpillé à son retour par les japonais et sombre dans l'Océan Pacifique.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Forcée de faire de longues heures de travail, la mère célibataire Maggie n'a pas d'autre choix que de laisser son fils de 12 ans sous la surveillance de son voisin Vincent.

programme.title: Pionniers malgré eux !
programme.desc: Ils sont venus pour l'or mais ils devront se contenter du plomb de leur tuyauterie.

programme.title: Madea, grand-mère justicière
programme.desc: Charles et sa femme Helen semblent tout avoir. Mais alors qu'ils se préparent à fêter leur 18e anniversaire, leur vie prend une tournure surprenante.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Forcée de faire de longues heures de travail, la mère célibataire Maggie n'a pas d'autre choix que de laisser son fils de 12 ans sous la surveillance de son voisin Vincent.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: L'existence de Lester est loin d'être parfaite. Il change quelques choses, devient plus libre, plus heureux. Mais Lester va bientôt apprendre que la liberté totale a un prix.

programme.title: Le droit de tuer?
programme.desc: Après le viol de sa fille de dix ans par deux Blancs qui se croient au dessus de la loi, le père se fait justice en abattant les deux violeurs.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: Quatre frères adoptés se retrouvent pour enterrer la femme qui les a élevés. Lors des funérailles, les frères découvrent que leur mère a été tuée et vont chercher à se venger.

programme.title: Rounders
programme.desc: Matt Damon, oscarisé, et Edward Norton jouent dans Les Joueurs. Un ex-accro au jeu (Damon) se retrouve à devoir jouer une partie pour sauver son ami.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview

Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Bling on the Bride
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey's envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners 2
programme.desc: For some brides, it's not about budget—it's all about the bling.Bling on the Bride is a one-hour documentary where today's shiniest trends take center stage. Wedding consultant Tara Mandy and event planner Steve Kemble will discuss the latest trends and most innovative ways to add bling to any wedding. Jewelry is where it starts, from the traditional engagement rings of Tiffany & Co to the high-priced engagement rings worn by the hottest celebrities and the finest wedding jewelry creations of “designer to the stars” Neil Lane.You'll meet wedding cake designer Ron Ben-Israel, known for the edible bling that adorns his creations. And Mark Ingram will show you how the hottest wedding gown designers are using bling to make their hostesses shine. And you'll meet Brooke Webster and see the lengths she'll go to make her wedding day sparkle and why for her there's just never enough bling.

programme.title: Day of the Dead Bride
programme.desc: David can't helped but be creeped-out when this bride-to-be has wedding day visions that bring the Dawn of the Dead to mind? With Halloween far away on the calendar, David has his work cut out for him to make sure this wedding looks less like a vampire movie video and more like one of his elegant events. With a bride who has a lust for blood, can David create a wedding to remember without inspiring guests to run screaming from the celebration?

programme.title: Greek Goddess Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's next bride thinks her fiancé is a "Greek god," and what else would that mean, but a Greek themed wedding?! Instead of an elegant affair, the bride wants statues, golden centerpieces and a bridal party outfitted in white robes. David quickly decides to tread lightly with this bride. For him there's a fine line between the Dionysian elegance of the brides' dreams and what could end up looking like a fraternity toga party!

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride's concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he's the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what's she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that's more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David's help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she's hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland Bride
programme.desc: Bride Chrissy Pumphrey-Duran and fiancé Jason Smith share a love for literature, so when it came time to decide on a theme for their wedding, they thought that Lewis Carroll's classic tale “Alice in Wonderland” would be perfect. But when David Tutera meets with the bride to see what she's come up with, he finds that Chrissy has gone way too far! From the black and white striped socks, she plans to wear under her black bridal gown to the chin-strapped top hats she's putting on her bridesmaids, this wedding needs a major rewrite! With only three weeks before the wedding, David rushes into action, changing Chrissy's dreary, gothic bridal gown to an elegant and dramatic gown worthy of her classic theme, gives the bridesmaids much needed color in their dresses, and moving the venue from a local club to a Hollywood soundstage. David even gives his bride a once-in-a-lifetime experience: a magical tea party with her as the guest of honor!

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). She grows rapidly within the world of intelligence, which had seemed like a totally different world to her, and shows great performance that even surprises the NIS agents.

programme.title: Hidden Japan

This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: mareTV: Newfoundland
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

If you want to get to the small town on the Pacific, you have no choice: there is only one road leading there, the Bella Coola Highway. It is constantly monitored and yet remains dangerous. Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode of the documentary series Andreas Kieling reports from the Amazon basin, Siberia, South Africa, the mountains of western China and the Eiffel region back home in Germany. Kieling ventures to western China almost as far as the border with Tibet in search of the great panda, the legendary bamboo bear. Set against a gigantic natural backdrop, the filmmaker is attempting to track down the extremely reclusive creature. But finding one of the approximately 3000 pandas who live in the vast mountainous landscape and capturing it on camera is like searching for a needle in a haystack. And then comes a stunning close encounter with the beautiful creatures at a very special place: the breeding station at Wulong. The precious bears live in huge natural enclosures here, breeding and providing specimens to be loaned to a number of zoos all over the world. These particular creatures are only able to serve as ambassadors for their few relatives who still live in the wild since they have become accustomed to captivity, they would not be able to survive by themselves in the rainforests.

programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: Camp Lakebottom

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: CRIME FILES

The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band SORAN! SORAN is one of Korea's top-notch bands composed of vocalist Ko Young-bae bassist Seo Myeon-ho guitarist Lee Tae-wook and drummer Pyeon Yu-il. Unlike what their band name means disturbance in English they offer lively poppy tunes that are relaxing and pleasing to the ears and have gained a steady following in the indie scene since their debut in 2009. Also known for their warm-hearted lyrics and their flawless performances the quartet never fails to get listeners in a good mood. Recently the four dropped their new mini-album Beloved and also held a free online concert titled Perfect Day 0 : Light Steps via YouTube providing a moment of refreshment to everyone around the world. In this episode SORAN performs Be with me the lead single from their new release Don't Lose Weight Ricotta Cheese Salad Confession Of Love and Our Journey. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four outstanding musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the quartet W24! This band burst into the music scene in March 2018 with the song Always Missing You. Composed of vocalist Cheong Ho-won guitarist Kim Yun-soo keyboardist Aaron Park and drummer Kim Jong-gil they compose write and produce all the songs they release and perform. Their name is short for World 24 Hours expressing the band's desire for their music to be heard 24 hours a day around the world. Thanks to their outstanding talents W24 won the Focus Award at the Asia Artist Awards in 2018 and the Best K-Pop Rookie Award at the 2019 Korea Culture Entertainment Grande Prize. Also they participated in The Asian Top Band a project to discover world-class musicians involving 8 Asian countries as the Korean representatives and became the winners. In this episode W24 performs Once Upon A Time Breath Under The Tree and more to show off thier musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Zitten! This artist made his debut in 2005 with the EP Rock Doves and has been nourishing the hearts of countless listeners with his delicate lyrical lyrics and heartwarming music since then. Also known for drawing his inspiration from various everyday elements he comforts our souls in a calm yet powerful way. Last December Zitten released the Christmas song All You Need Is A Carol to tell us not to take anything for granted. Then in January this year he started a new project to produce music inspired by places he visited books he read things he purchased and films he watched. The very first outcome of that new project is the song Little forest which he performs on I'm LIVE. He also performs Let's do well Something to say and more to showcase the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and meet Zitten!

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.
